description: Download Chromium (Chrome for Testing, Stable, about 200 MB) into the worker's cache (~/.cache/iii/browser/chrome) for a machine with no Chrome or Chromium. Returns at once with a job_id; progress arrives on the browser::chromium-install-progress trigger and in browser::chromium::status. A Chrome installed on the system still takes precedence. Does nothing when a Chromium is already found, unless force=true.

force.description: Download even when a Chromium is already found (a system one, or the same version already downloaded).

job_id.description: The install job; its progress arrives on the `browser::chromium-install-progress` trigger and in `browser::chromium::status` (`job`). Absent for `already-installed`.

oneOf.description: A new background job started; follow `job_id`.
A job was already running; `job_id` is that job.
Nothing to do: a Chromium is already found (`path`, `version`).
